ja.title: Sacituzumab tirumotecanを4 mg/kgから5 mg/kgに増やす価値はあるか：公開データで効果と毒性を比べる
ja.summary: 第1相の補足表S3のPK要約値と第2相TNBCコホートの集計値から、4 mg/kgと5 mg/kgの曝露、奏効、毒性を比べた。奏効の上積みは同定できず、好中球数減少と口内炎は5 mg/kg群で多く観測されたが、探索的な比較で多重性の補正後は有意とは言えない。非無作為化比較のため増量の因果効果ではない。

en.title: Is it worth increasing sacituzumab tirumotecan from 4 mg/kg to 5 mg/kg? Comparing efficacy and toxicity with public data
en.summary: Using PK summaries from phase 1 supplementary Table S3 and tallies from the phase 2 TNBC cohorts, I compared exposure, response and toxicity at 4 and 5 mg/kg. A response gain cannot be identified, and decreased neutrophil count and stomatitis were more frequent at 5 mg/kg but are not significant after multiplicity adjustment; this is a non-randomized comparison and not a causal effect of the increase.
en.seo_description: Exploratory comparison of sac-TMT 4 and 5 mg/kg using published PK summaries and phase 2 TNBC response and toxicity counts with Bayesian estimation.
en.seo_title: Sac-TMT 4 vs 5 mg/kg: worth the increase?
